name: Amazon-style catalog search and filtering
description: Verify the main storefront supports Amazon-style discovery controls and updates results.
steps: Change the price range and sorting
expected: The product grid updates to match the selected category, search query, price range, and sort order.

name: Product details and shopping cart
description: Verify a shopper can inspect a product and add it to the cart.
expected: The product details show the correct product image and information, and the cart shows the item and subtotal.

name: Wishlist and sign-in UI
description: Verify wishlist interaction and the no-credential demo sign-in guardrail.
expected: The favorite state changes and invalid email input produces a visible validation message.

name: Responsive mobile shopping
description: Verify the Amazon-style storefront remains usable on a phone-sized viewport.
expected: The menu, category selection, product grid, and cart remain usable without horizontal page overflow.
